list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete trinuclear Sm cluster contains three bridging S4²− units; each samarium is coordinated by one bidentate DippForm ligand and sulfur donors from the polysulfide units.

synthesis.procedure: Toluene was condensed onto [(DippForm)2Sm(thf)2] and S8 at −78 °C, warmed to ambient temperature, stirred for 12 h, then heated to 60 °C and stirred for a further 12 h. The mixture was filtered into a two-section ampoule and flame-sealed; crystals were grown by slow solvent evaporation. Additional suitable crystals for X-ray diffraction were obtained from an NMR tube using C6D6.
synthesis.time: 12 h at ambient temperature, then 12 h at 60 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Flame-sealed two-section ampoule; air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk/glovebox conditions
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered into a two-section ampoule and flame-sealed; crystals grown by slow evaporation. C6D6-grown crystals also reported.
synthesis.yield: 57 mg (72%; estimated assuming [(DippForm)3Sm] forms in equal amounts)

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete trinuclear Sm cluster contains three bridging S4²− units; each samarium is coordinated by one bidentate DippForm ligand and sulfur donors from the polysulfide units.

synthesis.procedure: Toluene was condensed onto [(DippForm)2Sm(thf)2] and S8 at −78 °C, warmed to ambient temperature, stirred for 6 h, then heated to 110 °C and stirred for a further 12 h. Toluene was removed under vacuum; the residue was extracted with n-heptane at −20 °C. After filtration and solvent removal, the residue was dissolved in toluene and crystallized by careful concentration at ambient temperature.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Toluene removed under vacuum; extracted with n-heptane at −20 °C, filtered, solvent removed, then dissolved in toluene and crystallized by careful concentration at ambient temperature.
synthesis.yield: 50 mg (13%; estimated assuming [(DippForm)3Sm] forms in equal amounts)
